I told Tobias in your DM that I'll remember Door 48 as his dock for Tansleigh Packaging pickups on the Saltire project.

gbrain had already saved his message as a private fact in his name, so only he can see it. I didn't save a second copy. The extra copy would have made the fact easier to find later, but I couldn't confirm the setting that keeps it private, and it might have been visible to other members. The saved fact isn't linked to Tobias, so a broad search could miss it. Searching with his name and the key words finds it. I didn't share his note anywhere else.
